title: Catch Rates and Feedback?
author: Warm-Comfort6536
selftext:
I've been working on a monster collecting game (ai generated pixel art style with card-based catching instead of pokeballs) and recently added visible catch rates and an animation when you capture a sprite successfully.

It now shows an actual percentage chance before you throw the card. I'm trying to make it feel user friendly.

Does it look good, does it feel user friendly? Any suggestions for extra UI elements around the catch rate popup? Is there anything I'm overlooking to make the capturing better?

Here's a link to the game if you want to test it:   
Game Link: [jaydenandressen.itch.io/pixelspritesuniverse](http://jaydenandressen.itch.io/pixelspritesuniverse)  
  
(Yes, Sprites are AI generated)
